title: How many colour receptors? A, B or C

scenes.headline: You see colour with 3 receptor types. How many does a mantis shrimp have?
Its eyes sample from deep ultraviolet to far red

scenes.label: colour receptor types in some mantis shrimp

scenes.headline: Yet it's worse than you at telling similar colours apart
scenes.body: In tests it struggled with close shades. It may scan and recognise colours fast instead.

caption:
More receptors, worse at shades.

In the 2014 study, mantis shrimp were trained to pick a colour for a food reward; they did well with very different colours, but accuracy dropped as the colours got closer together.

Source: Thoen et al. 2014, Science 343:411.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Multiple-choice quiz with a stat-layout answer and a twist that corrects the popular 'super colour vision' myth; options on screen, no comment bait.
